newsitem.title: INDIA: Calcutta shares end steady on dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Calcutta shares end steady on dull trade.

text.p: Calcutta shares ended steady on Thursday on dull trade, dealers said.

They said that scrips of ITC showed some volatility and moved sharply both ways in early trade before the Calcutta bourse pegged a trading range of 232 rupees and 256 rupees within which traders were allowed to strike deals.
Most other blue-chips like State Bank, Reliance Industries and TELCO recorded mid-session gains but failed to hold onto these levels, closing around previous closing prices.

"Traders and investors have been shaken by the steady fall in prices. Both buyers and sellers have retreated and are waiting for a definite trend to emerge before making fresh committments," said Aprajit Sharma of brokers Jet Age Securities.
There will be a special trading session at the Calcutta Stock Exchange (CSE) on November 10 between 5.30 pm and 7.30 pm to mark the Hindu Diwali festival.
